abstract:
This article introduces a conceptual reference framework – the Models
and Data (MODA) framework – to support a data-centric and model-driven approach for the integration of heterogeneous models and their respective data for the entire life-cycle of socio-technical systems.

A pre-print version is available at https://hal.inria.fr/hal-02612087
title: A Hitchhiker’s Guide to Model-Driven Engineering for Data-Centric Systems

abstract: Digital Twins are an emerging concept which is gaining importance in several ﬁelds. It refers to a comprehensive software representation of an actual system, which includes structures, properties, conditions, behaviours, history and possible futures of that system through models and data to be continuously synchronized.
title: Conceptualizing Digital Twins
